default.$description: Exists because Tokens Studio requires every field of a composite typography token. No design intent behind the value.

on-light.$description: Accent step for light surfaces. Chosen per brand so text on it clears 4.5:1 — the ramp number alone does not guarantee this.

on-dark.$description: Accent step for dark surfaces. Lighter than the light-mode step, with dark text on top.

control.$description: Corner character for buttons and fields. Part of brand identity, not just colour.

on-dark.$description: Accent step for dark surfaces. Lighter than the light-mode step, with dark text on top.

control.$description: Corner character for buttons and fields. Part of brand identity, not just colour.

accent.$description: Primary actions and active states. Carries the brand.

default.$description: The plane content sits on: surfaces, cards, fields.

subtle.$description: One step behind default: page background, wells, recessed areas.

disabled.$description: Inert controls. Signals unavailability, not error.

accent-subtle.$description: Tinted plane for callouts and selected rows. Never for body text without checking contrast.

muted.$description: Helper text, captions, placeholders. Secondary information only.

on-accent.$description: Text placed on background.accent. Flips polarity between modes — never assume white.

accent.$description: Links and active labels. A different ramp step than background.accent, so contrast holds.

default.$description: Decorative separation: card edges, dividers. Not interactive, no contrast requirement.

strong.$description: Borders of interactive elements: inputs, secondary buttons. Must meet 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

danger.$description: Invalid input state. Pair with an error message; never colour alone.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus indicator. Brand-coloured by design; audited against every surface it can appear on.

muted.$description: Helper text, captions, placeholders. Secondary information only.

on-accent.$description: Text placed on background.accent. Flips polarity between modes — never assume white.

accent.$description: Links and active labels. A different ramp step than background.accent, so contrast holds.

tight.$description: Label to control, control to hint. Within a single element.

default.$description: Between sibling blocks inside one surface: fields in a form, rows in a list.

loose.$description: Between top-level sections of a page. The largest gap in normal layout.

gap.$description: Between items on one line: buttons in a row, chips, badges.

padding.$description: Outer padding of the page shell. Not for surfaces — those use surface.padding

hairline.$description: Standard border width for surfaces, fields and dividers. Not for focus rings.

background.$description: One primary action per view. The thing you want the user to do.
Default for most actions. Primary is the exception, not the norm.

radius.$description: Shared by both variants. Variants differ in colour, not geometry.

label.$description: Above the control. Separate from field.text so labels can diverge later.

border-error.$description: Invalid state. Always pair with a message — never signal by colour alone.

hint.$description: Persistent guidance below the control. Replaced by field.error-text when invalid.

error-text.$description: Validation message. Sits on the surface, not inside the field.

gap.$description: Between label, control and hint. The internal rhythm of one field.

background.$description: Status tone. Subtle fill in light mode, neutral fill in dark to avoid glare.

width.$description: Ring thickness. An accessibility parameter, deliberately not brandable.

offset.$description: Gap between control and ring. Keeps the ring measured against a predictable surface.

radius.$description: Outer radius: control radius plus offset. Exists for Figma only — browsers derive this from border-radius.

color.$description: Keyboard focus indicator. Brand-coloured by design, audited against every surface it can appear on.

background.$description: Cards, panels and sections. The raised plane content sits on.

border.$description: Edge of a surface and dividers inside it. Decorative, no contrast requirement.

radius.$description: Corner of surfaces. Larger than controls; part of the brand's character.

padding.$description: Inner padding of a surface. Use layout.stack.* for gaps between its children.
